newsitem.title: USA: PVC Container resumes cash dividends.
newsitem.headline: PVC Container resumes cash dividends.

text.p: PVC Container Corp said directors declared a $0.06 per share dividend payable September 20, record September 30.

In February of this year the company paid a three percent stock dividend, and for the prior four years in a row paid a $0.05 per share cash dividend. The last of these payments was on January 18, 1995.
Earlier PVC Container reported a 58 percent jump in net income in the year ended June 30 on a six percent increase in revenues.

"Although lower polymer and raw material costs as well as higher capacity utilization of our manufacturing plants have favorably impacted earnings this year, our regional expansion of the plastic bottle business as well as our expanding sales into niche markets for rigid PVC compounds has played a major part in boosting earnings," the company said.

"While it is our desire to maintain dividends in the future, we will continue to emphasize the long term growth of the business, utilizing the major portion of our capital for strategic projects," it added.
